units.source_text: 源氏内大臣的行列走进深绿色的松林中，

en.t: Genji, the Inner Minister, and his procession entered the deep green pine grove,

units.source_text: 穿着浓浓淡淡的艳丽的官袍的人不计其数，好比撒了满地樱花与红叶。

en.t: and countless people in gorgeous court robes of many shades looked as though cherry blossoms and autumn leaves had been scattered all over the ground.

units.source_text: 六位的官员中，藏人的青袍特别显著。

en.t: Among the officials of the sixth rank, the blue robes of the chamberlains stood out especially clearly.

units.source_text: 前年流放时在途中赋诗怨恨贺茂社神的那个右近将监，现已升任卫门佐，俨然是个前拥后随的藏人大员了。

en.t: The Ukon no Jo who, when exiled the year before last, had composed a poem on the road resenting the gods of Kamo Shrine had now been promoted to Assistant Captain of the Gate Guards, and looked every bit like a high-ranking chamberlain with attendants before and behind him.

units.source_text: 良清也升任了卫门佐，此人比别人更加神气，身穿红袍，风姿十分俊俏。

en.t: Yoshikiyo, too, had been promoted to Assistant Captain of the Gate Guards; he looked prouder than anyone else, wearing a red robe and cutting a remarkably handsome figure.

units.source_text: 凡在明石浦见过的人，样子都全然改变，大家穿着红红绿绿的官袍，喜气洋洋地散布在这行列中。

en.t: All those who had been seen at Akashi Bay had changed completely in appearance, and now, dressed in red and green court robes, they were scattered through the procession in high spirits.

units.source_text: 其中年轻的公卿和殿上人，尤其争俏竞艳，连马鞍也装饰得绚焕灿烂。

en.t: Among them, the young nobles and courtiers competed especially fiercely in elegance and splendor, and even their saddles were decorated in dazzling brilliance.

units.source_text: 明石浦来的乡下人看了，真是吃惊！

en.t: The country people who had come from Akashi Bay were truly astonished when they saw it!
